messages:
maria: Draft of the product launch blog is up — please quick-pass for benchmarks, CTAs, and lead routing. Target publish Thu 03/26 09:00 PT. Doc: https://docs.redwood.in/launch/blog-draft (comments open).

alex: skimmed — strong narrative. major ask: we need a customer quote to support the latency/cost callouts, otherwise legal will flag.

sam: design options ready for hero — uploaded 2 variants to drive: A = product-in-context, B = chart-first. leaning A. want final by EOD tomorrow.

jordan: growth note — we need 3 inbound segments and explicit lead scoring so HS can route to the right queue. proposed routing: AE, SDR, nurture. also want a hidden field for "cohort" to tag early-access vs GA.

liz: legal quick note — the phrase "20x cheaper" is a comparative claim. need source or reword to "up to 20x lower unit cost in our tests" or add parenthetical with test conditions.

pat: adding benchmark methodology here so copy can cite it. we ran internal throughput tests across rw-13b/quantized and rw-7b, 1k sequences, seq_len=1024, batch=8, stable load. command we used:```bash
runtests --model=rw-13b --seq=1024 --batch=8 --profile throughput --iters=100
```Please do not assert the number without this context.

nina: analytics ops — for HubSpot form, use hidden fields: `utm_campaign`, `variant`, `lead_score`, `cohort`. Example hidden input snippet for the embed:```html
<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"cohort\" value=\"early-access\">
<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"variant\" value=\"A\">
```Routing rules I'll implement: `lead_score>=70 -> AE queue`, `40-69 -> SDR nurture`, `<40 -> marketing drip`. I also created a test submission flow and pixel on staging.

alex: +1 on the routing rules. also request the CTA text variants: "Try Redwood Optimize" vs "Get early access" — we should A/B test.

liz: legal OK if copy becomes: "up to 20x lower unit cost in our internal benchmarks (see methodology)". remove absolute phrasing like "20x cheaper".

sam: design picks variant A for hero, will attach export with bleed. naming: `hero_launch_A_v3.png`. uploading now.

jordan: I'll build the HubSpot form with the hidden fields and wire the workflow: 1) set `lead_score` from form + enrichment, 2) tag `cohort: early-access` if referral coded, 3) add to webinar nurture if registrant. Also will add a UTM rule for `utm_source=blog` so analytics can separate traffic.

pat: can marketing ops confirm embargo timing? I want to coordinate Dedicated customers and press. Proposed publish time 03/26 09:00 PT and embargo lift at that time. Also we need webinar registration embed — can someone supply code?

maria: thanks all — updated the doc with legal-friendly phrasing, added pat's methodology link, and inserted Nina's hidden field snippet. Next steps: Alex to finalize CTA variants, Sam to confirm hero asset, Jordan to set HS routing, Nina to validate tracking, Liz to final legal sign-off. Can everyone please sign off by EOD tomorrow so we can schedule publish? :calendar: :thumbsup:

alex: LGTM except waiting on the customer latency quote. pinging @emily-cust for a quick approval.

liz: legal sign-off pending customer quote. otherwise good with the new wording.

sam: uploaded final hero `hero_launch_A_v3.png` and a mobile crop. added alt text for accessibility.
jordan: routing rules in staging and workflows created. will run a smoke test once CTA is final.
nina: tracking pixel deployed to staging and test submission completed. sample test payload:```json
{"email":"test+hs@redwood.in","utm_campaign":"launch_q2","cohort":"early-access","lead_score":80}
```All good.

design-bot: calendar invite created for pre-publish review: 03/25 16:00 PT — linking doc and assets.

maria: final checklist (short): 1) hero asset in GH + drive (Sam) 2) CTA variants + copy (Alex) 3) HS form + routing (Jordan) 4) legal note + customer quote (Liz) 5) tracking pixel tested (Nina) 6) webinar embed code inserted (Pat) — once all green I'll schedule publish and socials. please drop a final :white_check_mark: when done.

alex: dropping :white_check_mark: — waiting on quote but copy/CTAs locked.

liz: once quote in, legal gives final :white_check_mark:.

pat: I'll paste the webinar embed once we have the final CTA (iframe + utm pattern).

maria: perfect — appreciate the quick passes. moving to schedule once we have quote. will follow up with the PR/press list separately.
